name: Colour grading LUT
oneLiner: The whole picture is graded through a 32x32x32 colour lookup table (a 1024x32 strip texture) on the I-08 WebGL post layer. Five original moods are generated in code (dusk, cold night, faded memory, high-contrast combat, toxic swamp), designers can load a .cube file or a PNG strip, and zones or story beats blend between tables over game time with grade.to('night', 1200). A lens pass adds a vignette and deterministic film grain. The HUD stays exactly as drawn (uiMask). Without WebGL, or with ?webgl=0, the game shows as plain 2D.
fits: any browser game drawn on one 2D canvas, pixel or HD
top-down adventure: one look per zone (village, swamp, cave) and per time of day
tactics and turn-based battles: a colder enemy phase, a combat look on the battle screen
story games: flashbacks, nightfall, a boss arena
side-scrollers and action games: one look per level or area
notFor: games already drawn with WebGL or a 3D engine (use their own LUT pass)
games without the I-08 webgl-post module (it is required and shipped alongside)
games that must look identical on machines without WebGL (the grade is progressive: no WebGL = no grade)

needs: I-08 webgl-post.js (GameDNA_Post), loaded first; the game's own I-08 instance is shared when it has one
the canvas element the game draws on
render() once per drawn frame on every draw path
the game's step-counted clock in ms (blends and grain follow it; deterministic ?t=&freeze=1)
where the player is: zone, phase or scene, to pick a look each step
optional: HUD and window rects in canvas px (uiRects) so the HUD stays ungraded
provides: a colour-grade pass (order 750) and a vignette + film-grain pass (order 860) on the I-08 chain
to(name, ms): idempotent blends between LUTs over game time; set(name): cut
six presets generated in code, plus define(name, recipe | .cube text | PNG strip | function)
the uiMask input (from uiRects) that every J-family pass reads to leave the HUD untouched
compare(x): before/after split of the same frame

variants.name: Filmic stack (keep the I-08 grade after the LUT)

assets: module/color-grade-lut.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_ColorGrade): recipe-to-LUT generator, .cube / PNG strip / array / function loaders, two-slot blending over game time, LUT and lens-grain shader passes on I-08, uiMask from rects, built-in grade replace/keep
requires elements/webgl-post/module/webgl-post.js (I-08), shipped next to it in the combo
no image or audio files: every LUT is generated in code

module.skin: optional: the vignette fades to the skin's palette.ink when skin-api.js is loaded and a skin is passed
